BT32 — momentum strategy, trade by trade

92 trades from bt17_trades_demo15.csv, each rebuilt from the cached 1-minute bars and resampled to the 5-minute frame the engine decides on. Support/resistance is recomputed as of the entry bar only — the levels the engine actually had, not the day's final ones. Costs are shown twice: bt17's stressed number (its own +0.40%/side slippage on top of real charges) and a realistic one recomputed per trade with the same itemised MIS model the engine books exits with (brokerage cap, sell-side STT, exchange, SEBI, stamp, GST). Descriptive report of an already-measured window — not a new test.
